lines.en: label norikofirsthall:
scene norikohall1
: Hey! What brings you over here today, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿！今天什么风把你吹到这儿来了，老师？

lines.en: : If you’re just wandering around the halls looking for something to do, might I suggest hanging out with yours truly?
lines.zh: : 如果你只是在走廊里瞎逛、想找点事做，我建议和我本人待在一起怎么样？

lines.en: : I heard from some of the others that you mope around here like some sort of lost puppy pretty often, and I would like to inform you that I am looking to adopt.
lines.zh: : 我听别人说，你经常像只迷路的小狗一样在这儿闷闷不乐地转悠，而我想通知你，我正打算领养一只。

lines.en: : I wasn’t looking to be adopted today, but I guess the two of us can hang out.
lines.zh: : 我今天没打算被人领养，不过我想我们两个可以一起玩。

lines.en: : If {i}you{/i} were looking to adopt as well, I would also like to make myself available as your dog.
lines.zh: : 如果{i}你{/i}也想领养的话，我也可以把自己交出来当你的狗。

lines.en: : You can walk me around on a leash and everything. Ami would love it.
lines.zh: : 你还可以用牵引绳牵着我到处走。Ami 肯定会爱死的。

lines.en: : I don’t think there’s anything in the world that Ami would hate more, actually.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这世上没有比这更让 Ami 讨厌的事了。

lines.en: scene norikohall2
: You’ve just gotta learn how to talk to her. Leave it to me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你只是得学会怎么跟她说话。交给我吧，老师。

lines.en: : If you say one word to her, I feel that the two of us may never see each other again.
lines.zh: : 你要是跟她说一个字，我觉得我们两个可能就再也见不到面了。

lines.en: scene norikohall3
: But I just got you back! That’s not fair!
lines.zh: : 可我刚刚才把你找回来！这不公平！

lines.en: : You're right. Which is why I regret to inform you that I can not walk you around on a leash {i}in public{/i}.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。所以我很遗憾地通知你，我不能牵着你{i}在公共场合{/i}遛。

lines.en: scene norikohall4
: Oh, right. I forgot that the public part was the first link in the chain of events that lead to us being separated once more.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我忘了“公共”这个环节，正是导致我们再次分离的那串事件里的第一环。

lines.en: : I can live with that as long as one of us gets to leash the other in private some time.
lines.zh: : 只要哪天我们其中一个能在私下里用绳子牵着另一个，我就能接受。

lines.en: : Noriko, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Noriko，我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: scene norikohall5
: You can ask me literally anything you want whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以问我任何想问的事。

lines.en: : Have you really been waiting years for me to walk back into your life?
lines.zh: : 你真的等了好多年，就为了我重新走进你的生活？

lines.en: : Well, I’m technically the one who walked back into yours. But yeah.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，是那个走回你生活里的人是我。不过，是的。

lines.en: : Then...how did you get so into this leash thing? Has this {i}always{/i} been a dream of yours, or...
lines.zh: : 那……你怎么会这么迷恋牵绳这回事？这{i}一直{/i}都是你的梦想吗，还是……

lines.en: : I have an overactive imagination that sometimes drifts into dangerous territory.
lines.zh: : 我有过于发达的想象力，有时候会飘到危险的领域去。

lines.en: : If you’re worried that it’s something I’ve experienced and thus have developed an unhealthy craving for, you are mistaken.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心那是我经历过的事、因而养成了不健康的渴求，那你错了。

lines.en: : Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : How so?
lines.zh: : 怎么有意思？

lines.en: : I just normally have to work a little harder to get girls this invested in me.
lines.zh: : 我只是平时得花更大的力气，才能让女孩对我上心到这种程度。

lines.en: scene norikohall6
: Hehe...yeah.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……是啊。

lines.en: : I still remember how hard you had to work to get Niki to like you back in the day.
lines.zh: : 我还记得当年你花了多大功夫才让 Niki 喜欢上你。

lines.en: : But as soon as you did it was like, all she ever talked about.
lines.zh: : 可你一得手，她张口闭口就全是你了。

lines.en: : Which is probably why {i}I{/i} started feeling all tingly really early too.
lines.zh: : 大概就是因为这个，{i}我{/i}才会那么早就开始对你心痒痒的。

lines.en: : Well, that and you were super cute back then.
lines.zh: : 嗯，还有那时候的你超级可爱。

lines.en: : Not to say that you’re not still cute, obviously. But now it’s more of a “mysterious older guy” cute and not “shirtless neighbor boy in the backyard” cute.
lines.zh: : 当然不是说你现在不可爱了。只是现在更像是“神秘大叔”的可爱，而不是“在后院光着膀子的邻家男孩”的可爱。

lines.en: : Well thanks for not ever making a move back then, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我还得谢谢你当年没出手，大概吧。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine that would have been good for my apparent previous relationship with a pop star.
lines.zh: : 我可想象不出，那对我那段显然存在过的、和一位流行歌手的恋情会有什么好处。

lines.en: scene norikohall7
: There’s no need to add “apparent” to that, Sensei. It definitely happened and it was a huge part of all of our lives.
lines.zh: : “显然”两个字就不必加了，老师。那件事绝对发生过，而且是我们所有人生命里巨大的一部分。

lines.en: : Even if you don’t remember it right now, I’m sure you will in time.
lines.zh: : 就算你现在不记得，我相信你总有一天会想起来的。

lines.en: : And once you do, I’ll be there to squeeze you and let you cry on my shoulder until your eyes turn so red and puffy that they swell shut and need to be surgically reopened.
lines.zh: : 而等你想起来的那天，我会在那儿抱着你，让你趴在我肩上哭，哭到眼睛又红又肿、肿得睁不开，得做手术才能重新撑开。

lines.en: : I can’t foresee myself crying any time soon, but thanks for the offer regardless.
lines.zh: : 我看不出自己近期会哭，不过还是谢谢你的好意。

lines.en: scene norikohall8
: Don’t mention it...I-
lines.zh: : 不客气……我——

lines.en: : I know it’s probably really weird hearing someone bring up the past so much when you’ve already clearly moved past it, but...
lines.zh: : 我知道，在你显然已经翻篇之后，还有人老是提起过去，大概真的很奇怪，可是……

lines.en: : There’s a life for you outside of this dorm, you know? Outside of the[school], too.
lines.zh: : 在这间宿舍之外，你还有属于自己的人生，你知道吗？在[school]之外也是。

lines.en: : And I make good enough money between my job and doing PA work for Nee-chan that I could {i}probably{/i} support the two of us if you wanted to just quit teaching altogether.
lines.zh: : 而且我打工加上给姐姐当助理赚的钱够多了，如果你想干脆把老师这行辞了，我{i}大概{/i}养得起我们两个。

lines.en: scene norikohall9
: But teaching has always been what you're good at.
lines.zh: : 可教书一直都是你擅长的事。

lines.en: : That’s why Maya and I turned out so darn smart.
lines.zh: : 所以我和 Maya 才会这么聪明。

lines.en: : Obviously, there was a lot of work that still had to be done outside of that creepy old apartment of yours-
lines.zh: : 显然，在你那套阴森的老公寓之外，还有很多功课要做——

lines.en: : Wait, Maya?
lines.zh: : 等等，Maya？

lines.en: scene norikohall10
: Yeah. The same Maya that's in our class and wants to turn my spine into a coat rack.
lines.zh: : 对。就是我们班上那个、想把我的脊椎做成衣帽架的 Maya。

lines.en: : You don’t remember that either?
lines.zh: : 那个你也不记得了？

lines.en: : Not at all...
lines.zh: : 完全不记得……

lines.en: : Well...how did you think the two of us knew each other, then?
lines.zh: : 那……你以为我们两个是怎么认识的？

lines.en: : I had no idea. She wouldn’t tell me anything about it. Just that you’re evil and going to ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道。她什么都没告诉我。只说你很邪恶，会毁掉一切。

lines.en: : How would I ruin anything at all? I’ve done literally nothing wrong since I’ve shown up here.
lines.zh: : 我到底能毁掉什么？自从我出现在这儿以来，我没做错任何事啊。

lines.en: : True. But, to be fair, that hasn’t been very long.
lines.zh: : 确实。不过说句公道话，时间也确实不长。

lines.en: scene norikohall1
: Well then, let me prove it to you.
lines.zh: : 那就让我证明给你看。

lines.en: : I didn’t wait all of these years to show up and get you to hate me or think I’m weird.
lines.zh: : 我等了这么多年，不是为了出现之后让你讨厌我、或者觉得我是个怪人。

lines.en: : And, if there’s anything you want to change, just let me know.
lines.zh: : 还有，如果有什么你想让我改的，尽管说。

lines.en: : Turn me into a sculpture.
lines.zh: : 把我雕成一座雕塑吧。

lines.en: : Make me your ideal girl.
lines.zh: : 把我打造成你的理想女孩。

lines.en: : Want someone with darker hair? I’ll dye it.
lines.zh: : 想要发色更深一点的？我就去染。

lines.en: : Someone skinnier? I’ll lose weight.
lines.zh: : 想要更瘦的？我就去减肥。

lines.en: : Please don’t lose any weight. You’re already extremely skinny.
lines.zh: : 拜托别减肥。你已经非常瘦了。

lines.en: : I can gain weight, too. Just say the word.
lines.zh: : 我也可以增重。你一句话就行。

lines.en: : Just...stay the way you are now.
lines.zh: : 就……保持你现在这个样子吧。

lines.en: : I’m not going to do something like ask you to change for me when I haven’t even identified any problems yet.
lines.zh: : 在我连问题都还没找出来之前，我不会干那种让你为我改变的事。

lines.en: : Except for maybe the pocket knife thing.
lines.zh: : 除了那把折叠刀的事。

lines.en: : Actually, yeah. Get rid of your knife.
lines.zh: : 对了，是的。把你的刀扔了。

lines.en: : Oh, the pocket knife stays. I need it to protect myself and conserve my chastity for you.
lines.zh: : 哦，折叠刀得留着。我需要它保护自己、替你守住我的贞操。

lines.en: : Fine. But get a holster or something so you don’t wind up slicing your leg open again.
lines.zh: : 行。但弄个刀套什么的，免得你又把大腿划开。

lines.en: : Roger that.
lines.zh: : 收到。

lines.en: : Anything else?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Give me your number.
lines.zh: : 有。把你的号码给我。

lines.en: scene norikohall2
: Nice. That was smooth.
lines.zh: : 不错。这招挺顺。

lines.en: : Are you going to text me at weird hours of the day asking for nudes?
lines.zh: : 你会在奇怪的时间给我发短信要裸照吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to send them if I do?
lines.zh: : 如果我发，你会给吗？

lines.en: : Uhhhh yeah? Duh.
lines.zh: : 呃，会啊？废话。

lines.en: : Just don’t post them online or show them to anybody else.
lines.zh: : 只是别发到网上，也别给别的人看。

lines.en: : Who would I even show them to?
lines.zh: : 我还能给谁看啊？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I heard you’re really close with that girl who wears the skull hairclip in our class and I get hardcore lesbian vibes from her.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我听说你和我们班那个戴骷髅发卡的女孩关系特别好，我从她身上感受到超强的女同气场。

lines.en: : But, actually, she’s cute. You can show her if you want.
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，她挺可爱的。你想给她看也行。

lines.en: : Just don’t let her know {i}I{/i} know because then it will be a whole thing and we might wind up fingering each other on a camping trip or something.
lines.zh: : 只是别让她知道{i}我{/i}知道，不然就会变成一整出戏，我们搞不好会在露营的时候互相用手指弄对方什么的。

lines.en: : Please invite me if that ever happens. I will never forgive you if you don't.
lines.zh: : 如果真有那天，请务必叫上我。你要是不叫我，我绝不会原谅你。

lines.en: : Also, why haven't you given me your number yet?
lines.zh: : 还有，你为什么还没把你的号码给我？

lines.en: : I’m still waiting for you to give me your phone.
lines.zh: : 我还在等你把手机给我。

lines.en: : I promise to not delete every single contact except for myself.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会把除了我自己以外的联系人全删掉。

lines.en: : That wasn’t a thing I was worried about until you said that.
lines.zh: : 你没说这话之前我还真不担心这个。

lines.en: scene norikohall9
: I was kidding, obviously.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的，显然。

lines.en: : You don’t actually believe the stalker thing that Maya said in class, do you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会真信了 Maya 在课上说的那个跟踪狂的说法吧？

lines.en: : Let’s just say if I were to rank the girls by “likelihood to follow me home after[school],” you’d be near the top.
lines.zh: : 这么说吧，如果要按“[school]放学后尾随我回家的可能性”给女孩们排名，你会排得很靠前。

lines.en: : And that’s pretty impressive given that we just met.
lines.zh: : 而我们才刚认识，这已经相当了不起了。

lines.en: : Just {i}reunited{/i}. And yeah, I’m definitely going to follow you home from time to time.
lines.zh: : 是刚{i}重逢{/i}。而且没错，我肯定会时不时地跟在你后面回家。

lines.en: : But I have zero qualms doing that alone {i}or{/i} as part of a group.
lines.zh: : 不过这种事我一个人做、{i}或{/i}者跟一群人一起做，都毫无心理负担。

lines.en: : Nothing would make me happier than just going out to karaoke with you, Ami, and that one blonde girl who thinks she loves you more than I do for some reason.
lines.zh: : 没有什么比和你、Ami，还有那个不知道为什么觉得自己比我更爱你的金发女孩一起去唱卡拉 OK 更让我开心的了。

lines.en: : Except for maybe making out with you in said karaoke booth while Ami and the blonde girl sing Misfits songs.
lines.zh: : 也许除了在那个卡拉 OK 包厢里和你接吻，而 Ami 和那个金发女孩在旁边唱 Misfits 的歌。

lines.en: : That fantasy seemed plausible up until the very end of it.
lines.zh: : 这个幻想一直到最后一秒之前都还挺合理的。

lines.en: : Gimme your phone.
lines.zh: : 把手机给我。

lines.en: : Oh, and if I {i}do{/i} send you nudes, please send some back.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果我{i}真{/i}给你发裸照了，请你也回发一些。

lines.en: : I know I said I have an overactive imagination, but visual aids still help a loooooot when I’m jilling myself off under the covers.
lines.zh: : 我说过我想象力过于发达，但我躲在被子里自己解决的时候，视觉辅助还是很有很大很大帮助的。

lines.en: : I have no idea why Maya doesn’t like you. You’re perfect.
lines.zh: : 我真搞不懂 Maya 为什么不喜欢你。你完美极了。

lines.en: scene black
Noriko takes my phone and enters her contact information into it.
lines.zh: Noriko 拿过我的手机，把她的联系方式输了进去。

lines.en: Not only does she slap a heart emoji next to her name, she inserts a puking emoji next to her sister’s name right above hers.
lines.zh: 她不但在自己名字旁边加了个爱心表情，还在上面姐姐的名字旁边加了个呕吐的表情。

lines.en: I figured the Kandas were going to be the only sibling war I found myself wrapped up in, but...
lines.zh: 我本来以为 Kanda 家会是我唯一卷进去的姐妹战争，不过……

lines.en: It seems that this is very much not the case.
lines.zh: 看来事实远非如此。

lines.en: And even though my experience with the Nakayamas (Or at least the experiences I am consciously aware of right now) is brief-
lines.zh: 而尽管我和 Nakayama 家的交集（至少是我现在有意识记得的那些）很短暂——

lines.en: I imagine this war will be much more...intense than that of the other one...
lines.zh: 我想这场战争会比另一场……激烈得多……

$ noriko_love += 1
$ norikofirsthall = True
{i}Congratulations! You now have Noriko’s number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在有 Noriko 的号码了！{/i}
